claims.statement: Saudi Arabia reported East-West Pipeline flows of 5.8 million barrels per day as Middle Eastern oil exports continued to recover.
The Gulf oil system is gaining redundancy through bypass capacity without eliminating the underlying chokepoint risk.
IEA discussions concern implementation details of the already agreed G7 100 million barrel emergency stock release, with detailed allocation still unresolved.
A developing Gulf of Mexico hurricane threatens US oil and gas production, but no confirmed physical supply loss was established by the evidence reviewed.
